summary: Frontend E2E testing of tipo_pilas + reclasificar-pilas feature. CronogramaProyectoModal reclassify flow on 'Torre Corporativa Demo' works end-to-end: panel + button render (data-testid='reclasificar-pilas-panel' / 'btn-reclasificar-pilas'), window.confirm() → success toast 'Pilas reclasificadas como Reforzamiento: 576 pzs planeadas movidas, 0 semanas del programa y 4 avances actualizados', UI refreshes with 'Reforz. Perfiles' card replacing 'Pilas Cimentación', backend confirms tipo_pilas='reforzamiento', pilas_planeadas=0, perfiles_planeados=576, total_pilas=0, total_perfiles=576, frentes actividades tag='reforz.'. Update-cronograma modal: after selecting file, tipo-pilas-selector with all 3 options (auto/cimentacion/reforzamiento) renders correctly. ImportarCronograma (create from Excel): parse OK, tipo-pilas-selector renders with all 3 options, clicking 'tipo-pilas-reforzamiento' re-parses and 'Pilas Cimentación' card disappears, 'Reforz. Perfiles' card appears with total 255, actividades tagged 'reforz.'. HOWEVER creating the project via 'Crear Proyecto' persists the project WITHOUT tipo_pilas / perfiles_planeados fields — see backend bug below.

critical.issue: Does not persist tipo_pilas, perfiles_planeados, cronograma_resumen, cronograma_archivo, or cronograma_fecha_carga on the new proyecto document. Verified: after uploading cronograma_tipos_test.xlsx with tipo_pilas='reforzamiento' via UI (which correctly reparses pilas→perfiles and passes tipo_pilas + resumen.total_perfiles=255 in request body), the resulting project has pilas_planeadas=0 (OK), perfiles_planeados=0 (WRONG, should be 255), tipo_pilas=null (WRONG, should be 'reforzamiento'), tiene_cronograma=false, cronograma_resumen=null. Only anclas_planeadas/muros_planeados/volumen_total_planeado are populated from resumen, and frentes are stored with tipo='perfiles' correctly. Root cause: /app/backend/routes/cronograma.py:62-165 builds the proyecto dict without reading data.get('tipo_pilas') or resumen.get('total_perfiles'); it only sets pilas_planeadas/muros_planeados/anclas_planeadas/volumen_total_planeado. Also never stores cronograma_archivo/cronograma_resumen/cronograma_fecha_carga, so tiene_cronograma comes back false and the reclasificar-pilas-panel won't appear on newly-created projects even though the panel's fallback pilas_planeadas>0 also fails (both are 0). Fix: add proyecto['perfiles_planeados'] = resumen.get('total_perfiles', 0), proyecto['tipo_pilas'] = data.get('tipo_pilas', 'auto'), and set cronograma_archivo='importado-desde-excel' + cronograma_resumen=resumen + cronograma_fecha_carga=now — mirroring the update endpoint pattern (see line 208, 228).

integration_issues.issue: UI correctly re-parses and shows 'Reforz. Perfiles' (255) preview, sends tipo_pilas + resumen to backend, but resulting project has perfiles_planeados=0 and tipo_pilas=null due to backend bug above. UI itself is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/cronograma.py:62-165 crear_proyecto_desde_cronograma is out of sync with the new feature: it accepts tipo_pilas in the request body (frontend sends it, line 109 of ImportarCronograma.jsx) but never writes it. Also missing perfiles_planeados from resumen even though aplicar_tipo_pilas correctly zeros total_pilas and sets total_perfiles.

CronogramaProyectoModal.jsx panel condition `((cronograma_resumen?.total_pilas > 0) || (pilas_planeadas > 0))` only shows inside the tiene_cronograma&&!showUpload branch. Combined with the backend bug above, newly-created projects from Excel never expose the reclassify panel. Once backend is fixed, this becomes moot.

ImportarCronograma.jsx uses `parsedData.resumen.total_perfiles > 0` in selector-visibility check (line 256), which correctly re-shows the selector after switching to reforzamiento even though total_pilas becomes 0. Nice.

rca_of_the_issue: crear_proyecto_desde_cronograma (routes/cronograma.py:62) was built before the tipo_pilas feature and never updated. The importar-cronograma parse endpoint and actualizar-cronograma update endpoint were updated (they handle tipo_pilas + perfiles_planeados correctly per lines 200-234), but the create-from-cronograma sibling endpoint at line 62 was missed. Frontend sends the fields correctly; backend silently drops them.
